long_biography.plain_text:
Piergiorgio Gabrielli led A.S. Cittadella during the club's rise from regional professional football to Serie B. Appointed president in 1995, he backed coach Ezio Glerean and oversaw the historic promotion of 2000, when a small-town team reached Italy's second tier for the first time.

Business responsibilities ran alongside the football role. As managing director of the family steel group and its Sofida holding, Gabrielli served during expansion that added processing companies, enlarged plants and developed a Porto Marghera site. He later left the club's board, yet continued joining family commemorations of its long association with Cittadella.
